# Jonas Wilinski

> ML engineer and PhD candidate at Hamburg University of Technology (TUHH). Builds NLP models (embedding models, LLM pipelines) and data infrastructure for scholarly data; former start-up CTO. Finishing the PhD in 2027 and looking for industry roles in applied ML, NLP and R&D.
